_comment: USD per 1M tokens, used to show what your usage would cost at standard API prices (your subscriptions are not billed this way). Models with all-zero rates show as unpriced. Model names must match the 'By model' table. Long-context, batch and fast-mode surcharges are not applied.

_sources.claude: Checked 2026-11-01 against https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing (standard rates). cache_write uses the 1-hour cache rate (2x input), which Claude Code uses; 5-minute writes are 1.25x input. Cache reads are 0.025x input on Fable 5.1, 0.05x on Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5, 0.1x elsewhere. Haiku 5.5 uses its rate for prompts up to 100K tokens; prompts over 100K cost 5x (0.50/0.625/1/0.05/2.50) and are not applied.
_sources.openai: Checked 2026-11-01 against https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing (Standard, short context): gpt-6-astra input/cache_write/cache_read/output = 10/12.5/1/50; gpt-6.1-sol = 2/2.5/0.1/10 USD per 1M tokens. cache_write uses the published 30-minute write rate. https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5.5 confirms input/cache_read/output = 5/0.5/30; no separate cache-write rate is listed. No official public API price or documented underlying-model rate was found for gpt-5.3-codex-spark or codex-auto-review; both are left unpriced (all-zero placeholders), excluded from dollar totals, and trigger the incomplete-pricing warning. Spark is not assumed to share gpt-5.3-codex pricing.
